basis: No published Blazor web head existed on the machine that wrote this file, and no document under docs/runbooks/evidence records its size. These limits are the only recorded browser-payload numbers, from docs/runbooks/evidence/avalonia-spike-2026-10-21/publish-size.txt (the Avalonia WebAssembly spike, the eight largest files: raw 15860498, gzip-9 5877729 bytes) plus 10 percent, and are a ceiling that the Blazor head must stay under, not a measurement of it. The Brotli limit reuses the gzip figure. Replace them with measured limits: publish apps/Autonogrammer.Web, then run node scripts/web-smoke/size-budget.mjs --write-baseline <publish>/wwwroot.
